urdu.name: کفایت

faq.q: What is the origin of Kifayat?

faq.q: What does Kifayat mean in Persian?

faq.a: Romanization variants include Kifayat, kifayat. Script forms are كفاية, کفایت, किफ़ायत.

faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
